description: The bar chart, titled "RoBERTa Size," compares the performance of different fine-tuning methods on models of varying sizes, with the vertical axis labeled "SQuAD Performance" ranging from 86 to 88. The horizontal axis lists several fine-tuning methods: "LoRA," "BitFit," "S₁-model," "S₄-model," and "S₅-model." Each method has two bars representing different model sizes: a blue bar for the "base" model and an orange bar for the "large" model. For all methods shown, the "large" model (orange) consistently outperforms the "base" model (blue). The "LoRA" method shows the highest performance for both model sizes, with the "large" model reaching a performance of approximately 87.8. The "BitFit" method has the lowest performance, with the "base" model scoring around 86.2 and the "large" model around 86.8. The "S₅-model" achieves the second-highest performance for the "large" model, with a score of approximately 87.5. The bars are arranged in descending order of performance for the "large" model, from left to right.
